summary: Iter74 backend verification of unified product management + Mogra Magic purge + Batch Allocation Dashboard: 8/8 pytest cases green (test_iter74_unified_products.py). (1) GET /api/admin/b2b/inventory returns 11 SKUs — Mogra Magic is fully purged from name/id/product_id fields both in the API response AND the b2b_products collection (verified via direct Mongo query with case-insensitive regex). Royal Kewda 50g + 200g present. Mystical Meharishi 100g present. Belpatra Dhoop 100g present. (2) POST /api/admin/products with a two-size test payload created the B2C product, response.b2b_skus_created=2, both mirrored SKUs materialised in b2b_products with correct category derivation (50g→'agarbatti', 200g→'agarbatti_jar'), correct opening_stock seeding (30 → stock_pieces=30 stock_status=in_stock, 0 → stock_pieces=0 stock_status=out_of_stock). (3) PUT /api/admin/products/{id} re-syncs MRP (120→200 propagated to b2b_products.mrp_per_unit) while preserving stock_pieces (still 30, opening_stock=999 in payload correctly ignored on update). (4) GET /api/products and /api/products/{id} both enrich sizes[].stock via the unified B2B pool — bold-bakhoor 50g carries an integer stock field. (5) Batch allocation endpoints: /api/admin/b2b/preorders/batch-allocation returns {skus:[], totals:{orders,retailers,pieces,token_paid_inr,balance_due_inr}} with correct shape; /api/admin/b2b/preorders/by-sku/royal-kewda-b2b returns {product_id,product_name,orders:[]}. (6) Regression: /api/brochure/download returns application/pdf, 55–200 KB, %PDF header. /api/retailer-dashboard/b2b/calculate returns 401 without a retailer session (routing intact, no 500). Frontend UI walkthrough BLOCKED — the public preview URL (https://fragrance-rewards.preview.emergentagent.com) is currently in the Emergent 'Ready to start your preview / Wake up servers' sleeping state, so no in-browser end-to-end checks of /admin/b2b/inventory, /admin/b2b/preorders or /retailer/b2b are possible in this run. Static source grep confirmed there are ZERO references to 'Mogra Magic' in /app/frontend-next/**, so the string cannot leak into the UI even once the preview wakes up. Backend confidence: 100%.

critical_code_review_comments: product_sync.mirror_b2c_product correctly guards against stock wipe on updates (uses `if existing:` branch to preserve stock_pieces). Well-defensively coded.
product_sync.deduct_stock_for_b2c_order uses b2b_inventory_log row as an idempotency guard — safe against duplicate webhook calls.
admin_b2b_preorders.batch_allocation proportionally distributes order-level token/balance across per-SKU buckets via line_total/subtotal weight — mathematically sound for multi-line invoices.

Nit: NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend-next/.env.local hardcodes the sleeping preview URL. If the deployment ever migrates preview URLs, all /api rewrites break silently. Consider making this a build arg fed from CI.
